service_truncation: ... {shown} of {total} {unit} shown (narrow the request or raise the budget for the rest)
ceiling_truncation: ... output truncated at the {max_tokens}-token ceiling: {dropped} of {total} lines dropped
json_ceiling_untrimmable: payload exceeds the {max_tokens}-token ceiling and cannot be trimmed; request less data or raise the budget
json_ceiling_trimmed: payload exceeds the {max_tokens}-token ceiling; narrow the request or raise the budget
json_ceiling_oversized_item: payload exceeds the {max_tokens}-token ceiling and the first item alone does not fit; it is returned whole, so this payload is over the ceiling
